fields.description: Salva is a three to five bedroom villa collection at The Heights Country Club and Wellness. Its design places homes among landscaped trails, reflective courtyards and outdoor fitness spaces. Shared wellness facilities form part of the wider community, while the individual villa layouts offer a choice of room arrangements and outdoor space.

research.community: The Heights Country Club and Wellness
overview: Emaar’s Salva page emphasises parks, outdoor movement and garden spaces. These shared facilities describe the community setting; the position of a particular home, its outlook and the access route to each amenity still depend on the selected plot.
research.locationNote: Salva is part of The Heights Country Club and Wellness, connected towards E611 and E77. Compare the selected villa’s access to everyday services with your own travel pattern. The development’s southern Dubai setting is not a promise of a fixed drive time.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently lists units from AED 6,762,888, while its key facts also show an earlier AED 6 million starting figure. The higher published unit-price display is used here as a dated reference, with the chosen villa’s price and availability to be confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The Emaar-branded Salva launch sheet hosted by a broker gives the schedule below. Bayut agrees on the 10/70/20 split but lists different dates for the later construction milestones. The copied phase-specific sheet is shown as launch information; only a current developer-issued schedule can establish the terms of a new booking.
research.handoverNote: The Salva launch sheet estimates construction completion in July 2030, within Bayut’s reported Q3 2030 handover quarter. Completion and key handover may be separate steps. Confirm the current contractual date and any applicable provisions directly in the sales documents.
